description: The three Excel operations that write more than one cell, on a Svelte 5 spreadsheet grid: Paste Special with values, formulas, formats, transpose and arithmetic, carried on a text/html clipboard flavour so formats survive a round trip through Excel; Find and Replace that searches what you see but writes what you typed, so replacing a formula's result does not destroy the formula; and row and column insert and delete that rewrite every reference, widening =SUM(B1:B4) when a row is inserted inside it. Enterprise, in @svgrid/enterprise.
keywords: svelte grid find and replace formulas

faq.question: What does Paste Special offer?
faq.answer: All, Values, Formulas, Formats, plus Transpose and the Add, Subtract, Multiply and Divide operations, the same set as Excel's dialog, applied to the copied block at the selection.

faq.question: Does Find and Replace break formulas?
faq.answer: No. It matches against the displayed text so you can search for a result, but the replacement is written into the cell's raw text, so a formula cell keeps being a formula.

faq.question: What happens to references when a row is inserted?
faq.answer: Every formula on the sheet is rewritten: references below the insert move down, and a range that spans the insert point grows to include the new row.
